title: Whispering Whorl Whelk
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, it drifts through a tank of deep teal water and slow shafts of amber light, leaving a trail of tiny glowing bubbles that pop with a soft 'pff-pff.' It spends its days collecting smooth pebbles and stacking them in a crooked tower beside a curl of kelp, and every so often it stops to admire the tower, tipping its tentacles like a very small architect.
